title.narrative: Programa de Reforma del Sector Salud

description.narrative: PROJECT CONSISTS OF INSTITUTIONAL REFORM OF THE HEALTH SECTOR AND ASSOCIATED INVESTMENTS. REFORM COMPONENT INCLUDES DECENTRALIZATION OF SERVICES THROUGH THE CREATION OF REGIONAL HEALTH AUTHORITIES, REORGANIZATION OF THE MOH; INVESTMENT COMPONENT INCLUDES RATIONALIZATION AND UPGRADING OF THE HEALTH SERVICES INFRASTRUCTURE. STUDIES ON SECTOR FINANCING, LEADING TO THE CREATION AND PHASED INTRODUCTION OF A NATIONAL HEALTH INSURANCE SCHEME ALSO INCLUDED.
